parameters.body:
from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: -30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["signal"] == "tmp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["topic"] =~ /^1\/1\/CB(1M|2M|1[1-8]|2[1-8])\/tmp$/)
  |> group(columns: ["topic"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time","_value","topic","signal","equipment","sensor_id","site"])
  |> yield(name: "latest_tmp")
